d:
Is fashion still just about clothes, or has it become the ultimate statement of power, personality, politics, and pop culture? From Sydney Sweeney's controversial sports campaign to Zendaya's show-stopping red carpet looks, Virat Kohli's evolving sportswear journey, and Sabyasachi's global luxury ambitions, fashion is changing faster than ever. And everyone seems to have an opinion!
In this episode of What In The Fashion? by Firstpost, Aisha and Amakshi dive into the biggest fashion trends, celebrity controversies, fitness obsessions, and style moments shaping today's culture.
